# Load libraries 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


# Import data

```{r}
metadata_ereef <- read_csv("data/metadata/metadata_ereef.csv")
```

# Data manipulation 

```{r}
env_var <- metadata_ereef |> 
  select(-Population) |>
  scale(center =TRUE, scale =TRUE) 

ran_var1 <- as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(6 * 100), nrow = 6, ncol = 100))
ran_var2 <- scale(ran_var1)

env_var_baypass <- cbind(env_var, ran_var2)
```

# Export data 
```{r}
write.table(env_var_baypass, "baypass_env_metadata.txt", col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
